title: Privileged third-party support access without session recording
description: Vendor support engineers (database, observability) granted just-in-time prod access during incidents but sessions not recorded or replayed.

title: Production data at rest unencrypted on a legacy reporting replica
description: A legacy analytics replica of the customer database runs on an instance whose EBS volume was never enabled with encryption-at-rest. Schedule for decommission slipped.
currentMitigations: Replica network-isolated to bastion access only; firewall rules audited monthly.

title: Insufficient TLS configuration on internal service mesh
description: Service-to-service traffic inside the cluster uses self-signed certs rotated annually rather than automated short-lived mTLS.
currentMitigations: Cluster network is private; ingress is TLS 1.3-terminated at the edge. Internal compromise is the only realistic threat vector.

title: Sub-processor list outdated on Trust Center
description: Customer-facing sub-processor list lags actual deployed vendor footprint by ~60 days. Disclosure obligations under DPA may be breached.
currentMitigations: Quarterly Trust Center refresh scheduled. Considering automation to sync from CMDB.

title: Quarterly vendor security review backlog
description: Annual SOC 2 reviews for ~40 critical vendors are tracked in a spreadsheet. Most recent review predates the org's adoption of Vanta.
currentMitigations: Spreadsheet exists but is months out of date. Backlog tracked in Jira but de-prioritized.

title: Insecure-by-default S3 bucket policy from analytics vendor
description: A third-party analytics integration deployed an S3 bucket with public-list permissions on first install. Discovered in 2023 audit.
currentMitigations: Vendor patched in 2023-Q4; remediation verified; bucket-policy regression test added to deployment pipeline.

title: Self-hosted on-prem analytics pipeline (decom planned)
description: Legacy on-prem analytics pipeline runs on aging hardware. Identified for decommission and migration to managed cloud service.
currentMitigations: Migration project scheduled for 2026-Q3. Existing pipeline accepted as out-of-scope for further investment.

title: Limited observability on the new internal admin tool
description: Internal admin tool (built this quarter) lacks structured access logging. Cannot reconstruct admin actions in an incident.

title: Backup restore tested only on synthetic data
description: Backup restore procedure verified monthly with synthetic test data only. Full production restore drill is annual and was last successful 14 months ago.
currentMitigations: Annual restore drill scheduled for 2026-Q3. Synthetic monthly verification continues. Risk accepted in the interim.

title: Critical-vendor pricing model lock-in
description: Single LLM-inference vendor whose pricing model puts us at risk of unsustainable monthly cost increases. No portability layer.
currentMitigations: Multi-vendor LLM adapter shipped 2025-Q4. Migration capability validated; pricing risk fully transferred to commercial team.
